title: Exterior free-boundary minimal surfaces of every topological type with at least two ends
summary: An exterior free-boundary minimal surface is a properly immersed minimal surface in the complement of the open unit ball of $\mathbb{R}^3$ whose boundary lies on the unit sphere and meets it orthogonally. We prove that for all integers $\ell\geq2$, $b\geq1$ and $γ\geq0$ there is a connected, orientable, properly embedded exterior free-boundary minimal surface with $\ell$ ends, $b$ boundary components and genus $γ$.
